tei:div.tei:p: chos rgyud byon tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ lha pa'i thog ma/ gnyos lo tsā ba rin chen grags pas/ rgya gar du byon nas/ slob dpon chen po bha ling ta a tsar+ya la/ chos don thog tu dril la/ kha zin che ba zhig zhu byas pas/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs kyi skor gnang*/ las kha tshar tshang ba zhig zhu byas pas/ gshin rje dgra nag gnang*/ la chung zha ི ga gi tsa na dgra yod pas/ bka' bsrung zhig yang zhu byas pas/ 'jigs byed la ṭaka shad sbrel nas gnang*/ phag rgyud skor gsum zhes grags te/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de'i sras slob dpon rdo rje bla ma/ pha rgyud skor gsum la mkhas zhing*/ bod kyi mi chen bzhir grags pa'i/ ya ba zhig yin/ de'i sras/ dpal seng ge'i sras/ gnyos nag grags pa dpal/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi sku skye yin par zhang rin po che'i lung bstan/ khong gis sras/ ras chen gnyos lha nang ba de/ rgya gar gyi nag po spyod pa chung ba yin par zhang rin po che'i lung bstan 'dug cing*/ tsa rir byon dus mkha' 'gro mas kyang lung bstan to/ /zhang gi drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ 'bri khung chos rje'i drung du/ nā ro chos drug gsan/ tsa ri ti se sogs la byon/ sgrub pa nan tan che bar mdzad/ mon gyi pa gro bcal kha la sogs par/ tshogs pa yang thog re bskyangs/ byang du lha nang btab/ lha pa nyis stong brgyad brgyar grags pa yang de nas byung*/ khong gi dbon po/ lha rin chen rgyal de nyid/ lha sras mu ne btsan po'i sku skye yin skad/ skyor mo lung du rab byung mdzad/ pha rgyud skaur gsum la mkhas / bcal kha sa g.yos kyi sgyel ba'i tshab/ phag ri rin chen sgang brtsigs/ lha nang du gdan sar bzhugs pas/ rgyal khrims che ba'i dmag sna'i gnod pa byung bas/ skyid smad du byon nas/ rab grong brtsigs lha nang du/ khu'u'i bla ma grub thob 'dam seng gdan sa la brdzangs/ 'dam pa rigs pas nye gnas byas/ gye re dgon pa btab cing*/

gye re lha khang gi gtsug lag khang brtsigs/ de'i dbon rgyud/ bla ma dar ma rgyal po dang*/ de'i dbon po lha gzi brjid rgyal po/ chos kyi rgyud pa ni/ lha rin chen rgyal po khu dbon la/ mkhas pa dge brag pa tshul gzhon gyi thug de'i slob ma mkhas pa byang dar/ de'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs gzi rjid rgyal po la sogs/ lha rabs bris pas lha mi kun/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/// PAGE 292 mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/lha pa'i bla rabs dang*/ chos rgyud byon tshul/ -PAGE 292--PAGE 273--PAGE 272-
